items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: He got that from FATS NAVARRO -- between me and Milt Jackson and it is Pass The Parcel, is what it is.

ctx.x: I (inaudible) How High the Moon. I showed him the riffs on it. The next thing I know, they had Fats Navarro with him.

(Singing.) (Inaudible) And went back to California. And we had broke him in. He stood in with Milt Jackson, Milt showed him how to lay behind the beat. Hamp could do it, too. close like Milt was showing him. He could play bebop with feeling, And I came to rehearsal one day, early, he was at the piano with Sonny Burke, showing Sonny "How High The Moon", and they were writing -- I didn't know they were writing a tune -- (singing).
